scope_zh: 此文件规定未来完整保存/恢复补丁、验证产物及Drive提交协议；它不是已实现的序列化器、CLI、模型checkpoint或已通过测试的证明。

checkpoint_policy.trigger_combination: any due condition; coalesce conditions for the same completed iteration
checkpoint_policy.safe_boundary: after an entire iteration, including Actor/Critic optimizer steps and EMA update, has completed; before the next iteration mutates state
checkpoint_policy.wallclock_reference: monotonic elapsed time since the last complete local checkpoint capture, or this attempt training start before the first capture
checkpoint_policy.wallclock_due_action: set a due flag and capture at the next completed iteration boundary; do not interrupt an optimizer update or capture a partially updated state
checkpoint_policy.rpo_note_zh: 900秒是保存触发阈值，非远端最多丢失900秒的承诺。实际恢复损失从最近已远端验证快照算起，还受当前迭代、保存、上传、校验和重试时间影响。
checkpoint_policy.final_iteration_scope: 500 is the main-screening target in this plan; a later continuation forces a final snapshot at its actual resolved total_iterations target

checkpoint_identity_template.completed_iteration_semantics: number of fully completed outer iterations; 0 before the first iteration; loading 500 means next iteration 501
checkpoint_identity_template.resume_capability_verification_condition: Promote to FULL_STATE_VERIFIED only when the declared full-state implementation/restore checks and this generation integrity evidence pass; final continuation entries also require the designated fresh-runtime 500-to-501 handoff test.

models.module_training_modes: save or deterministically reconstruct and validate all modes affecting subsequent computation
models.evaluation_primary_export: EMA policy compatible with the existing evaluator; store separately from the full training bundle

include: learning rates and other group options
actual cumulative actor and critic optimizer-step counters
optimizers.missing_component_policy: reject full-state restore; never silently initialize a missing optimizer
optimizers.main_matrix_state_dtype: preserve original dtypes, including FP32 floating master/momentum state

required: actual current actor and critic learning rates
schedules.validation: recompute the next iteration schedule from the saved resolved config and compare with uninterrupted execution

required: each field name, shape and dtype
replay.capture: pause mutation and write bounded trajectory/field shards from the preallocated replay; no whole-buffer clone or deepcopy
replay.stored_region: store all valid ring slots with their exact positions; reconstruct unused allocated slots by the versioned allocation rule; when full, store all capacity slots
replay.readback: allocate CPU replay once, load bounded shards into correct slots, then validate size/pointer/layout/data
replay.sample_validation: restore the relevant RNG state, compare sampled indices and contents including ring wraparound
replay.sample_rng_reference: record the actual Torch CPU/CUDA or explicit generator used by the executed replay implementation
replay.bounded_shard_storage_requirement: A serialized shard must own only its bounded payload, or use a proven slice-aware format. torch.save of a view can persist its entire shared backing storage; a merely contiguous view is not proof of an independent bounded storage.
replay.bounded_copy_policy: A small bounded shard may be copied to independent storage and released after serialization; cloning/deepcopying the whole replay is forbidden.
replay.loader_peak_memory_requirement: Read one bounded shard at a time directly into the final preallocated CPU replay and release its temporary storage before the next shard; alternatively adopt compatible tensor storage without an extra complete replay allocation.
replay.forbidden_loader: Do not torch.load a complete replay-sized bundle and then copy it into a second preallocated replay. For A3, two raw full replay copies alone are 14.865478515625 GiB before all other state.

required: resolved SamplerConfig including actual env_seed, R, B, sampling temperature and cache dtype
all valid partial rollout_buffer tensors and per-environment lengths
sampler.conditional_state: preserve last_step_rewards/last_step_is_terminal or reconstruct and validate them if subsequent code reads them before overwrite
sampler.kv_cache_policy: derived cache may be reconstructed at the validated complete-iteration boundary from saved partial histories using the current actor, as the audited collect path rebuilds it; verify this path in the fork test
sampler.next_collect_validation: same next delivered trajectory batch and ordering under the declared deterministic test conditions

native_environment.primary_planned_method: reset from the recorded initial environment seed and replay the exact full native action journal prefix
required: boundary observations, legal actions, reward and terminal comparison evidence
native_environment.native_rng: native mt19937 progress is reconstructed by the full action history and all automatic post-terminal resets; recording only unfinished games is insufficient
native_environment.future_alternative: versioned native snapshot/restore of real fields and RNG after separate equivalence validation; never raw-dump C++ pointers/vectors

required: all used independent NumPy generators and their identifiers
all explicitly created Torch generators and their identifiers
rng.restore_order: restore after model/optimizer/buffer/environment construction, journal replay, cache preparation and RNG-consuming validation setup; no accidental random draws before the resumed next operation

logical_counters.main_single_gpu_consumed_trajectory_inva: B * completed_iteration from initialization; exclude unfinished and unconsumed sampler trajectories

required: execution SHA plus source bundle reference

journal_prefix_contract.recording_boundary: record the complete CPU action-token batch associated with every actual EnvBatch.step; snapshot commits only the prefix successfully applied through the safe boundary
journal_prefix_contract.raw_action_payload_bytes_formula: native_step_batch_count * R * 5 * 8, equivalently total_env_steps * 5 * 8 when total_env_steps counts individual environments advanced
journal_prefix_contract.origin: the one recorded initial EnvBatch.reset(actual_env_seed) before any journal action
journal_prefix_contract.ordering: monotonic native step-batch sequence numbers; no gaps, duplicates or reordering
prefix_manifest_required_fields: ordered shard artifact refs with byte sizes and SHA256
first and last native batch index for each shard
exact final shard valid byte offset with declared encoding/header semantics
journal_prefix_contract.offset_semantics: identify logical uncompressed action payload and physical file encoding separately; do not interpret a logical offset as an offset inside a compressed stream
journal_prefix_contract.replay: reset the same native environment build; call the existing actions_from_np and envs.step in exact order without GPU policy inference until the recorded prefix ends
journal_prefix_contract.journal_compaction: only after an independently validated native snapshot replaces the origin for every remaining dependent checkpoint
journal_prefix_contract.restoration_claim: conditional on passing state and next-transition equivalence tests; same seed alone is not proof

required_artifact_roles: train_state with models, optimizers, EMA, RNG, counters and provenance
replay layout manifest and all required replay tensor shards
sampler state and partial/commit trajectory shards
journal prefix manifest and every referenced immutable historical journal shard
complete resolved config and environment/dependency/source references
generation manifest with all file sizes and SHA256 values
COMPLETE.json written only after remote verification

configuration_compatibility.default: reject differences outside the explicit operational whitelist; resolve the full saved config rather than reconstructing from current defaults
whitelist_conditions: total_iterations is an absolute target greater than or equal to completed_iteration and does not change scientific schedule definitions
full-state resume requires both optimizers, replay, sampler and RNG restoration; resume_optimizer=false is rejected
record parent config hash, complete resolved child config hash and exact allowed changes
freeze scientific values, execution SHA, precision/backend, seeds and compatible software/native environment
changing B/R/M/S, optimizer, model, discount/lambda/clip/reg/LR schedule/EMA, precision or backend creates a declared new experiment branch
main 12-job comparisons use the same checkpoint/timing/logging policy; a later continuation may change allowed operations with explicit provenance
configuration_compatibility.full_config_hash_semantics: hash the complete canonical resolved configuration; retain it even when allowed operational changes create a new full hash
configuration_compatibility.scientific_config_hash_semantics: hash canonical scientific/effective numeric fields after excluding only the declared operational whitelist; compare values as well as hashes
configuration_compatibility.legacy_checkpoint_policy: may be inspected as MODEL_OPTIMIZER_ONLY or an explicit WARM_START branch; missing historical state cannot be reconstructed after the fact

load_order: Select a specific verified generation; check manifest, COMPLETE, all files and all referenced journal prefix shards.
Load serialized tensors initially with map_location=cpu; do not map the whole bundle to CUDA.
Resolve saved configuration, validate compatibility/whitelist and provenance, construct model/optimizer/replay/sampler objects in the locked environment.
Reset native environment with the actual saved origin seed and replay the complete journal prefix without GPU policy inference.
Restore current actor, EMA actor/updater and critic; place model and optimizer tensors onto their declared GPU devices while replay remains on CPU.
Restore replay ring, partial/commit sampler state, parsed environment result, logical counters and schedule inputs; prepare derived cache and non-mutating comparison evidence.
Restore all RNG states last; if probes consume RNG, restore the same saved state again.
Continue with next_iteration=completed_iteration+1 and the corresponding unchanged scientific schedule; record a new attempt with the exact parent generation.

drive_publish_protocol.generation_id_policy: new unique identifier for each captured immutable generation; failed upload retries the same frozen generation
steps: Pause mutation at the safe iteration boundary; synchronize outstanding CUDA work required for coherent tensor capture.

Write bounded independent-storage shards or a proven slice-aware format into a temporary generation; prevent torch.save(view) from serializing a whole shared replay storage. Seal the journal prefix, close handles and compute per-file byte counts/SHA256, then publish the immutable local generation.
Upload immutable files to this attempt dedicated new remote generation using verified resumable upload or the pretested Drive mount copy path.

Verify remote byte size and content using independent API server checksum with a locally computed checksum of the same algorithm, or independently download and recompute SHA256 if usable server evidence is unavailable.
Record the actual verification algorithm and evidence; a server MD5 result must not be labeled a server SHA256 verification. A reader verifies downloaded file SHA256 against the manifest.
Write COMPLETE.json last with exact artifact IDs/paths, sizes, hashes, config/execution identity, boundary iteration, journal prefix and remote verification evidence.
Optionally update the per-run latest_verified pointer; readers still validate the complete generation and all referenced files.
Retain previous verified generations until the new generation and its complete dependency set are verified; record upload failures as UPLOAD_PENDING.
drive_publish_protocol.async_upload_input: frozen local files only; never live mutating replay/model tensors
drive_publish_protocol.aggregate_ledger_writer: single coordinator; each worker writes only its own attempt records

assertions: filled and overwritten ring preserves size/pointer/fields
same restored RNG yields identical replay sample indices and data
multiple completed games and post-terminal resets
unfinished games and sub-action boundaries
same next observation, legal actions, reward and terminal result
nonzero commit leftovers and partial rollouts are present in the test snapshot
first resumed collect matches delivered trajectory contents/order
continuous N+K versus fresh-process restore at N then K
compare next schedule, logical counts, RNG, replay, sampler, optimizers, EMA and parameter updates
deterministic path comparisons exact where supported; fast-mode numerical tolerances and nondeterminism sources declared before seeing results
bounded CPU serialization and load at every candidate capacity
no whole replay clone
memory/disk evidence covers full capture and load
repeated-data fixture is not throughput, compression or training evidence
a shard view does not cause serialization of its entire backing replay storage
peak memory passes during both capture and restore, including temporary shard copies
loading does not hold a full decoded replay in addition to its final preallocated storage
missing replay rejected
missing Critic optimizer rejected
missing required sampler/RNG/EMA state rejected
journal prefix truncated/corrupt/out-of-order rejected
wrong byte count/hash/schema/model shape rejected
scientific config mismatch rejected
incomplete remote generation rejected
no silent empty-replay fallback

real_data_filled_replay_gate.evidence_phase: after real replay fills; a main run may provide this evidence, with further execution paused if its gate fails
real_data_filled_replay_gate.if_separate_pretest: use a separate pretest identity; exclude its trajectories and timings from the 12 main run results
real_data_filled_replay_gate.failure_action: pause further training until the recorded failure is resolved and revalidated

handoff_gate.minimum_required_models: A0 seed29 and the selected distinct candidate seed29; deduplicate if the selection is A0
required_steps: download the declared complete 500 parent in a new runtime
verify every manifest and file including all journal prefixes
reconstruct the full state and actually execute training iteration 501
store validation logs, compared fields, hashes and an independent verification branch
handoff_gate.continuation_choice: start official continuation from the verified 500 parent or explicitly from the 501 verification child; record the choice and never count it as another training seed

retention_policy.active_run: retain the latest two verified full generations when available and every journal prefix shard they reference; pending uploads never replace a verified parent
retention_policy.evaluation_exports: retain all 12 runs complete configurations, source/environment fingerprints, metrics, 250/500 EMA policy exports, model/optimizer checkpoints and all raw evaluation results
retention_policy.before_selection: prefer retaining every run final full 500 generation; pre-register a capacity-aware archival policy if storage does not fit
retention_policy.final_minimum_full_resume: A0 seed29 and selected distinct candidate seed29 complete 500 generation plus journal prefixes and fresh-runtime 500-to-501 evidence
retention_policy.other_seed_full_replay_policy: retain according to measured quota; preserve their weights/results and declare reduced resume_capability if large state is deliberately removed
deletion_gate: check dependency references across every retained generation
confirm A0 and selected continuation gates passed
do not remove the only recoverable parent
do not touch pre-existing doudizhu files outside this campaign

notes_zh: 500轮统计与运行资源采用计划中的12个逻辑job口径；动作journal重放、失败重做和恢复验证的成本另外记账。
CPU replay负载是张量静态量，不等于系统RSS、显存峰值、压缩包大小或实际传输量。
schema、日志、序列化、loader、远端验证与验收当前均为待实现要求；execution_sha和实际artifact refs必须由执行阶段填写。
